paragraphs: From Buncrana Test Centre depart and take the 1st left onto the local road.
At the end of the road turn right.
Take the next left.
Take another left onto a small unnamed road and pull in safely when asked.
Move off and carry out a U-turn on the quiet unnamed road when instructed.
Turn right at the end of the road.
Take the next left onto the through road.
Continue for about 700 metres and turn right onto another unnamed section.
Drive for roughly 1 km and at the end of the road turn right.
Turn right again at the next junction.
Continue for about 500 metres and turn left.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit on the left.
Move off and turn left, then take the 1st right.
Take the next left, then turn right onto Castle Avenue.
Take the next left onto Cair O' Dohertaigh Avenue and pull in for a technical question or parking check.
Move off and turn right onto Church Street.
Continue straight ahead as the road becomes Aileach Road.
Turn left onto Saint Oran's Road.
At the end of the road turn right.
Take the next left into a quieter area for a controlled stop.
Move off and turn left onto Dr. Denis McLaughlin Road.
Turn left onto Lower Main Street.
Take the next right onto Saint Oran's Road.
Turn right onto Aileach Road.
Take the final left to return towards Buncrana Test Centre.
